story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. `growth_stage` field accepts exactly four values: `seedling`, `budding`, `evergreen`, `withered`. 2. Invalid `growth_stage` values trigger a Hugo build error with a clear message identifying the offending file and the allowed values. Layers 1 (Zed editor) and 2 (pre-commit hook) provide earlier feedback; Layer 3 (Hugo errorf) is the authoritative gate. 3. Default value resolves to `seedling` when the field is omitted from frontmatter (consumed by templates with the fallback `default "seedling" .Params.growth_stage`). 4. Archetype templates `archetypes/articles/index.md` and `archetypes/logs/index.md` include `growth_stage: "seedling"` by default. 5. Field is documented in archetype comments with all four allowed options explained (seedling = early/draft, budding = developing, evergreen = mature/maintained, withered = deprecated).

story-context.constraints: - Additive-only change to archetypes: NEVER modify existing frontmatter fields (title, date, draft, weight, categories, tags, series, authors, summary, params.SEO.*). Only add `growth_stage`. - Frontmatter field naming: snake_case (`growth_stage`). Established convention; downstream stories add `format`, `last_significant_update`, `pinned`, `withered_*` consistently. - Single Source of Truth for the schema: `schemas/frontmatter/article.schema.json`. Layers 1 (Zed) and 2 (pre-commit) read this file. Layer 3 (Hugo errorf) hardcodes the enum independently. When future stories add fields/values, update BOTH the schema AND the Hugo partial(s) — note this in story-1.2 onwards. - Hugo `errorf` pattern: invoke from `layouts/baseof.html` (CONFIRMED location, NOT `layouts/_default/baseof.html`). Mirror style of `layouts/_partials/card.html:89`. Error message MUST include `.File.Path` AND the allowed-values list. - Default-value fallback (AC #3) is a TEMPLATE-CONSUMER concern. Establish convention `default "seedling" .Params.growth_stage` for downstream stories. The build-time validation partial uses an `if $stage` guard so missing/empty values do NOT trigger errorf — they fall through to the consumer fallback. - Partial location: `layouts/_partials/_base/validate-growth-stage.html` — `_base/` is for core layout/init partials. Existing _base/ partials confirmed: head.html, hero.html, navigation.html, footer.html, seo.html. - Filename casing: kebab-case (`validate-growth-stage.html`), matching existing repo convention. Architecture doc occasionally proposes PascalCase for partials — codebase reality is kebab-case; FOLLOW THE CODEBASE. - Pre-commit hook MUST be skip-aware (exit 0 silently if no content/.md files are staged). Bypass via `git commit --no-verify` is acceptable as escape hatch. - Zed YAML LSP frontmatter validation may be limited — if it doesn't work cleanly, document the limitation in editor-setup.md and rely on Layer 2 (pre-commit) as authoritative pre-build gate. DO NOT block Story 1.1 on Zed UX polish. - Playwright bootstrap: chromium-only, ONE smoke test. Visual regression / journey / a11y / multi-browser come in Story 1.2 (badge) and downstream per `docs/2-solutioning/test-design-system.md`. Don't expand scope here. - CI workflow MUST be CREATED FROM SCRATCH at `.github/workflows/test.yml` — repo currently has no `.github/workflows/` directory. Branch protection setup is manual — note the requirement in PR description. - Out of scope: badge rendering (Story 1.2), withered hiding (1.3), warning banner (1.4), RSS/SEO (1.5/9.6), migration of existing articles (tracked in `docs/todo.md` "Manuelle Aufgabe: Growth-Stage-Migration"), full Playwright matrix. - Build must continue to succeed for all existing articles (no `growth_stage` field) via the fallback path (AC #3) — this is the regression guarantee.

interface.name: growth_stage frontmatter field
interface.signature: growth_stage: "seedling" | "budding" | "evergreen" | "withered" (string; optional in existing content; default "seedling" via consumer fallback)
interface.path: archetypes/articles/index.md, archetypes/logs/index.md (definition); schemas/frontmatter/article.schema.json (formal schema); consumed by templates via `default "seedling" .Params.growth_stage`

interface.name: article.schema.json
interface.path: schemas/frontmatter/article.schema.json (NEW). Used by Layer 1 (Zed YAML LSP) and Layer 2 (pre-commit ajv).

interface.name: validate-frontmatter.js (pre-commit)
interface.signature: Usage: `node scripts/validate-frontmatter.js`. Reads staged .md files from `git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM`. Filters to content/articles/**/*.md and content/logs/**/*.md. Returns exit 0 (pass / no-op) or non-zero (fail with per-file error report).

interface.name: validate-growth-stage partial
interface.kind: Hugo partial (no return value, side-effect: errorf on invalid input)
interface.signature: {{ partial "_base/validate-growth-stage.html" . }} — receives current page context; halts build via errorf when .Params.growth_stage is set and not in {seedling, budding, evergreen, withered}; no-op when field is missing or empty (consumer fallback handles it)

interface.name: default-value fallback expression
interface.signature: {{ default "seedling" .Params.growth_stage }} — used by every consuming template (Story 1.2 badge and downstream)
interface.path: convention; documented in archetype comments and docs/technical/editor-setup.md

interface.signature: "prepare": "husky" | "test:build": "node --test tests/build/" | "test:e2e": "playwright test" | "test": "npm run test:build && npm run test:e2e"

tests.standards:
Authoritative test plan: `docs/2-solutioning/test-design-system.md` (Test Architect Murat, 2025-11-15). Stack: Playwright (E2E + visual regression + axe-core a11y) + Node test runner (`node --test`, built-in since Node 20) for build smoke + script unit tests + `act` (optional) for local GitHub Actions testing. The older `architecture.md` "No Automated Tests Found" line describes the brownfield baseline and is SUPERSEDED.
Story 1.1 BOOTSTRAPS test infrastructure for downstream: build smoke tests in `tests/build/` (with `tests/build/fixtures/`), minimal Playwright config + ONE smoke test in `tests/e2e/`, CI workflow at `.github/workflows/test.yml` (created from scratch — no existing workflows). Visual regression / journey / a11y tests live in Story 1.2 (badge visual regression) and downstream per the test-design plan — do NOT expand scope here.
Manual verification still required for end-to-end sanity (editor squiggle behavior, pre-commit hook UX). Hugo build verification: `hugo` (development) and `hugo --environment production` must both succeed/fail correctly per AC #2 — both paths must invoke the validation partial via baseof.html.
tests.locations: - tests/build/fixtures/ (committed test fixtures: valid-evergreen.md, valid-missing-field.md, invalid-stage.md) - tests/build/ (build-smoke.test.mjs — node --test runner, no extra runtime deps) - tests/e2e/ (smoke.spec.ts — Playwright; foundation for downstream visual/journey tests) - playwright.config.ts (root) - schemas/frontmatter/ (article.schema.json — single source of truth) - scripts/ (validate-frontmatter.js — pre-commit script) - .husky/ (pre-commit hook) - .zed/ (settings.json — workspace editor settings) - .github/workflows/ (test.yml — created from scratch) - docs/technical/ (editor-setup.md, testing.md — short docs cross-linked from README) - content/articles/, content/logs/ (DO NOT commit ad-hoc test articles here — use tests/build/fixtures/ instead)
tests.ideas: - AC #1, #4: `hugo new content articles/test-stage-default` → file contains `growth_stage: "seedling"` and explanatory comment with all four values. Same for logs archetype. - AC #1: build-smoke fixture `valid-evergreen.md` (and one per stage variant) → hugo build exits 0. - AC #2: build-smoke fixture `invalid-stage.md` → hugo build exits non-zero AND error output contains the fixture's .File.Path AND the allowed-values list. - AC #2 (Layer 1): in Zed, opening `invalid-stage.md` shows red squiggle on the growth_stage line BEFORE saving. Manual smoke check. - AC #2 (Layer 2): `git add invalid-stage.md && git commit -m test` is BLOCKED with the validator's per-file error message. Bypass-able only via `--no-verify`. - AC #2 (Layer 3, prod path): Same failure under `hugo --environment production` (validation MUST run in prod, not just dev) — covered by build-smoke test using the production env flag. - AC #3: build-smoke fixture `valid-missing-field.md` (no growth_stage) → hugo build exits 0; in a probe template (or visual confirmation in Story 1.2 once the badge renders), `default "seedling" .Params.growth_stage` resolves to `"seedling"`. - AC #5: open both updated archetypes and confirm inline comment lists all four values with one-line descriptions. - Regression: build the full site with NO changes to existing content; all existing articles continue to build successfully via fallback (this is the most important regression check — DO NOT break the existing site). - Edge case: empty string `growth_stage: ""` — confirm validator treats empty as "missing" (per AC #3 fallback) rather than as an invalid value. The Hugo `if $stage` guard handles this; the schema should also allow missing/empty (use `oneOf` with null-or-enum-or-omitted) OR treat the field as optional with `additionalProperties: true`. - Playwright smoke: `tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` — homepage GET 200 AND `` present. Regression canary for Hugo updates. - CI smoke: PR-triggered run of `npm run test:build && npm run test:e2e` — both must pass before merge. Branch protection setup is manual (out of code scope). - Pre-commit no-op: stage a non-content file (e.g., README.md change) → pre-commit exits 0 silently (skip-aware behavior verified).
